comment: The fixture was saved by the build before the move, from box-blur-exercise.sad with the box blur attached to Layer 1 at radius 7 and an effect layer called Box effect above it carrying the box blur at radius 12, both under the key box_blur.box_blur. This build opens it: the look and texels are read against the old build's own look of the same file, and each attached row is pressed so the filter panel prints the record's key and radius. Then the Filter menu is shot, its Blur section listing Box Blur once, and the state names every module loaded, box_blur not among them.
